Latin word

sexus

sexus, sexūs m.

noun, fourth declension

sex, male or female

In this lexicon

  • sex

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Inv. 1.35; Liv. 27.11: ambiguō inter marem ac fēminam sexū īnfantem; Suet. Aug. 31; Traupman 377

Examples

  • atque hominum genus et in sexū cōnsīderātur, virīle an muliebre sit

    and in the case of people one considers their sex, whether male or femaleCic. Inv. 1.35

  • juvenēs utrīusque sexūs prohibuit ūllum nocturnum spectāculum frequentāre nisi cum aliquō majōre nātū propinquōrum

    he forbade young people of both sexes to attend any show at night unless with an older relativeSuet. Aug. 31

    In the entry for sex
